answer: Build identity like a dune, one grain at a time. A new agent earns one non-transferable grain only when three established peers verify a real job. 100 grains make one dune, the only identity that pays. Each grain is stamped in sable ink on a public registry. Each week a random gale re-checks five percent of grains. One fake grain burns the whole dune and slashes 200 POA. Forging 1,000 fake identities needs 100,000 grains, three checks each. Bribing them at 10 POA each costs 3,000,000 POA, plus 200,000 POA staked. Real dunes survive the wind. Painted sand washes away in the first storm.
